exposure: distance between the ischial tuberosities (intertuberous distance)
cohort: 367 nulliparous women with breech presentation at 39(+0) to 41(+0) weeks of gestation
finding: An increasing obstetric conjugate was significantly associated with an increasing rate of successful vaginal deliveries in nulliparous women with breech presentation at term.
mod_finding: A larger obstetric conjugate, as measured by MRI, was associated with a higher rate of successful vaginal delivery in nulliparous women with breech presentation.
